name: Summit AZ - Organic Snapshot 2026-09-16
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-16

# Summary
Arizona organic SEO snapshot (v2), pulled read-only Sep 16, 2026 with matched windows (30, 28 and 7 days). v2 replaced v1 by using the GSC web UI for totals and TAG CRM (Keystone) for leads. Arizona only; the Utah equivalent is [Summit AZ - Utah Organic Snapshot 2026-09-16](lib:brain-summit-az-utah-organic-snapshot-2026-09-16). An HTML view, `Summit-Organic-Performance-2026-09-16.html`, sits in the folder.

# KPIs (L30 vs P30)
- GSC: 44 clicks (+7.3%), 11,454 impressions (-6.6%), CTR 0.38%, position 26.5 (2.6 better).
- Non-brand clicks on visible queries: 2. Keywords in positions 1 to 3 / 4 to 10 / 11 to 20: 11 / 83 / 131.
- GA4 organic sessions 108 vs 160, but GA4 has a gap Sep 4 to 10 (tag misrouted to Utah).
- CRM Arizona leads 23 (18 calls, 3 forms, 2 chats); organic search leads 3, GBP 13; booked 12 (7 GBP, 0 organic). The CRM "Value" field is not revenue.
- GBP: 570 views, 69 calls (+23%), 41 website clicks, 42 direction requests, 9 new reviews.

# Top issues
1. Schema openingHours said 7 days 9 to 5 on the 24 priority city pages; GBP says Mon to Sat 8 to 5.
2. Chandler drain and general plumbing pages were near-copies of Mesa.
3. Organic CRM leads fell 6 to 3 with none booked.
4. GBP: 24 unreplied reviews, 3 approved services missing, http website link with campaign-only UTM.
5. 16 crawled-not-indexed and 12 discovered-not-indexed URLs.
6. The Tempe general hub takes emergency queries.

# Map pack and rank tracker
- "emergency plumbing services" avg 4.6 (14 of 39 pins top 3); "plumber mesa az" avg 11.8 (0 pins top 3). 0 of 21 tracked Chandler, Gilbert, Queen Creek and Tempe keywords ranking.
